method: Seven-link pseudo-inertia semidefinite least squares from homogeneous placeholders; physical constraints and weak regularization; armature stabilization and local constrained joint-loss refinement using prescribed full candidate observations.
limitations: Effective parameters are not unique link inertias; the regressor resolves approximately 69 combinations of 98 coefficients.
Measured torque and kinematics are filtered; the model does not recover raw actuator commands.
